blocks.title: Therapeutic window
blocks.text: Therapeutic window plasma mein dawa ke un concentrations ki had hai jo nuqsan-deh zimni asraat (side effects) ke baghair mo'assar hon. Yeh dawa ka 'behtareen hissa' hai: itna kam nahi ke be-asar ho aur itna zyada nahi ke khatarnak ho.

items: Minimum effective concentration (MEC): dawa ki woh kam tareen satah jis se neeche woh ilaji asar nahi deti.
Minimum toxic concentration (MTC): woh kam tareen satah jis par dawa nuqsan-deh asraat ya 'zehr' dena shuru karti hai.
Duration of action: woh waqt jab tak dawa ka concentration therapeutic window ke andar rehta hai.

blocks.alt: Graph: drug level in plasma (oopar) aur time (daen). Banafshi curve tezi se barhti, MEC (hari dashed) aur MTC (surkh dashed) ke darmiyan hari therapeutic window patti mein choti tak jati, phir dheere dheere MEC se neeche girti hai. MEC ko do martaba kaatne wale nuqton ke darmiyan doharay teer par 'duration of action'.
blocks.caption: Aik khurak ke baad plasma mein dawa ki satah: MEC, MTC aur duration of action (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dawa lene ke baad khoon mein us ki satah barhti hai, choti par pohanchti hai aur phir jism use nikalta rehta hai. Jab tak satah MEC se oopar aur MTC se neeche (hari patti mein) rahe, dawa asar karti hai aur nuqsan nahi deti; yahi waqt 'duration of action' hai. MTC se oopar satah zehreeli, aur MEC se neeche be-asar hai.

Chauri therapeutic window ka matlab hai ke dawa ki hifazati hudood kushada hain, kyunke kaam karne wali aur nuqsan dene wali khurak mein bara faasla hai; is se khurak mein zyada gunjaish milti hai. Tang window ka matlab hai dawa kam mehfooz hai, kyunke mo'assar khurak zehreeli khurak ke bohat qareeb hai. Doctors ko aisi dawayein likhte waqt bohat ehtiyat karni parti hai aur aksar mareez ka khoon check karna parta hai taake dawa ki satah tang had ke andar rahe. Kai dawayein aik saath lena, genetic awamil, motapa, umar ya aam sehat bhi dawa ki therapeutic window badal sakte hain, kyunke yeh dawa ke metabolism aur asar par asar dalte hain.

blocks.prompt: Dawa ke duration of action se kya murad hai?
blocks.explanation: Woh waqt jab tak khoon mein dawa ka concentration us ki therapeutic window, yani MEC aur MTC ke darmiyan, rehta hai.

items: Therapeutic window: plasma satahein jo nuqsan ke baghair kaam karein.
MEC: is se neeche asar nahi; MTC: is se oopar zehreela.
Tang window: dawa ki satah ki nigrani zaruri.
